name: @pryzm/constraint-solver
description: PRYZM 2 — 2D sketch constraint engine behind a `SolverPorter` contract. Ships a deterministic `MockSolver` (five first constraint kinds: distance-pp, parallel, perpendicular, coincident-pp, fixed) and an HONESTLY-LABELLED planegcs scaffold (`PlanegcsAdapter`, kind='mock', intendedEngine='planegcs'). No real planegcs binding exists in this repo, and none is authorised until C74 §4.2(c) is answered for a named constraint family (C74 §4.5). Also hosts the REAL `./compliance` advisory rule registry.
